description: This source file defines a function to migrate legacy user defaults keys to a new prefix within an iOS/macOS application's user defaults storage. It reads all stored preferences, filters those with a specific legacy prefix, and updates or adds them with a new prefix if they are not already present.

methods.name: migrateLegacyDefaults
methods.description: Migrates user defaults keys with a legacy prefix to a new prefix, copying values where the target key does not already exist.
